title: Pressure-Robust Fortin-Soulie Elements of the Stokes Equation on Curved Domains
summary: This paper presents a pressure-robust and element-wise divergence-free nonconforming finite element method for the Stokes problem on curved domains. The discrete element is constructed by mapping the Fortin-Soulie element from a reference triangle using an isoparametric mapping for the geometry and a Piola transform for the function space. The inf-sup condition and the error estimate with optimal convergence rate are proved.
